title: chore(app-shell): the dead slot refreshKey parameter is removed (#4549)
body:
Fixes #4549

## The premise did not survive measurement

The card says the Data pillar "has no refreshKey path at all". Measured on current `main`: it has one, and it works. The slot's refresh signal reaches the grid today.

plugin-view's ObjectView holds **one** `refreshKey` useState and hands it to the `renderListView` slot **twice**:

- `schema.refreshTrigger` — `packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx:1057`
- a bare `refreshKey` argument — same call, `:1063`

Only the first is a real input. `ListView` lists `schema.refreshTrigger` in its fetch effect's dependency array (`packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx:1609`); `refreshKey` is a prop of neither `ListView` nor anything it renders — the dead forward #4528 measured and removed. And `renderStudioGridList` spreads the slot schema into `ListView`'s schema, so `refreshTrigger` rides that spread. The pillar has been refreshing through it since f591c5df3 (2026-03-25).

So the ruling's preference order lands on **option 1 already satisfied**: ListView's existing declarative refresh input is not merely available, it is already connected. Nothing needed wiring — no key-fold, no handle, no remount, and no `plugin-list` change. Scroll position, selection and in-progress inline edits were never at risk.

### Step 0 — does the signal bump on the Studio path?

Yes, via one of the six increment sites. The other five are unreachable from this mount:

| site | reachable in Studio |
| --- | --- |
| `:327` onMutation auto-subscribe | no — guarded by `if (renderListView) return;` |
| `:586` handleDelete | no — wired only to the built-in ObjectGrid branch |
| `:591` handleBulkDelete | no — same branch |
| `:598` handleFormSuccess | **yes** — the slot passes `onEdit`/`onAddRecord`, Studio wires both into ListView's toolbar, and a successful submit bumps |
| `:608` handleRefresh | no — never referenced anywhere (filed as #4568) |

Since it bumps, deletion-for-never-bumping was not the outcome; deletion still is, for the corrected reason that the same number already arrives on a live channel.

## What changed

- The unread `refreshKey` parameter is dropped from `renderStudioGridList`'s signature.
- The comment claiming wiring it would be a behaviour change is corrected — it asserted the opposite of what is true, and would have sent the next reader to build a second refresh path on top of the working one.
- A comment on the spread pins why `refreshTrigger` must not be dropped or shadowed there.
- New tests pin the channel.

## Tests

`packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.gridRefresh.test.tsx`, driving the **real** slot function:

1. bumping the slot's signal refetches;
2. it keys off the signal **VALUE**, not renders — three re-renders each handing a fresh schema literal with an unchanged counter produce zero extra fetches (the ruling's no-storm pin);
3. the real plugin-view ObjectView emits `schema.refreshTrigger` and `refreshKey` in lockstep, which is what makes the harness in 1 and 2 faithful rather than a fiction.

### Reverse verification

A behaviour-neutral deletion has no red-first direction, so the honest check is severing the live channel instead. Adding `refreshTrigger: undefined` after the spread turns test 1 red:

```
AssertionError: expected 1 to be greater than 1
```

Tests 2 and 3 stay green there, correctly — no refetch at all still satisfies "no storm", and the producer contract is untouched. Restore verified by sha256 (`b09de723c17ed610...`).

## Verification

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/` — 25 files, 144 tests passed (the #4558 panel/inspector suites among them, untouched).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` — both tsc passes clean.
- ESLint net zero on the touched files: 0 errors / 15 warnings, identical to the `origin/main` baseline. The test-only export trips `react-refresh/only-export-components` (a render-prop callback is not a component), so it carries one narrowly-scoped, justified disable.
- `check:control-bytes`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check-changeset-presence` green; control-byte self-scan over every touched file clean.

## Changeset

Empty frontmatter — the gate's documented first-class answer for a no-behaviour-change `src/` edit. Verified both ways: `@object-ui/app-shell`'s public `dist/index.d.ts` is **byte-identical** before and after (`index.ts` re-exports a named list, and `package.json` exports only `.`), so the test-only export widens nothing. Note `skip-changeset` is not a mechanism in this repo — `scripts/__tests__/ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts:184` records that neither that workflow nor that label was ever real.

## Findings filed, not fixed

- **#4567** — the Studio grid issues a duplicate `find()` on **every render**: `ListView` depends on the `columns` array by identity, and `StudioDesignSurface:2600` rebuilds `table.fields` with `.map().filter()` each render. Measured 1 fetch to 4 across three no-op re-renders; hoisting the array to a stable identity drops it to zero extra. Upstream of this slot and orthogonal to it, so out of scope here — but it is why test 2 hoists its columns, which would otherwise mask the value-vs-render distinction.
- **#4568** — `handleRefresh` in plugin-view's ObjectView is declared and never referenced (`finding`).
